title: hyparrhenia macrolepis
intro: Hyparrhenia macrolepis, commonly known as Elephant's Grass or Green Panic Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in African folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Hyparrhenia macrolepis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
